{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Drop rows with invalid revenue values
sales_df = sales_df.dropna(subset=['revenue'])

# Ensure only completed orders are considered for conversion
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Stratify by customer_segment and compute conversion rates within each stratum
stratified_rates = sales_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack(level='channel')

# Compute the difference in conversion rates within each segment
stratified_diff = stratified_rates['email'] - stratified_rates['paid_search']

# Compute the overall difference using stratification (weighted average)
# Weight by proportion of each segment in the overall sample
segment_weights = sales_df.groupby('customer_segment').size() / sales_df.shape[0]

# Apply weights to each segment's difference
weighted_diff = (stratified_diff * segment_weights).sum()

# Print results
print('Stratified conversion rates by channel and segment:\n', stratified_rates)
print('\nDifference within each segment (email - paid_search):\n', stratified_diff)
print('\nWeighted average difference (stratified):', weighted_diff)"}
